label: Subagent • parallel batch: same local model fans out, both complete
query: One spawn_batch call starts two children on the same local model.
notes: Model-free. Two scripted children share one local model identity and one residency handoff, then execute in the same production local subwave. Peak overlap must be exactly 2, both caller-stable rows must settle successfully, and the production aggregate must be succeeded. The separate heterogeneous fixture proves that different local model identities still serialize while remote work overlaps.
